exact_statement: Every finite Boolean function admits a terminating genuine disjoint read-once decomposition into essential primes, constants and literals, where a prime has no block B of size 2 through n-1 with exactly two distinct cofactor rows. The corrected product-biased inequality Hplus<=C(I-Var) holds for all primes of all arities and all interior product laws iff it holds for every Boolean function under every interior product law, with the same C. Either condition implies ordinary uniform FEI with constant max(C,log2(e)). The exact labeled census has 10,104,57240 essential primes and 0,114,7354 essential decomposable functions at n=2,3,4 respectively. No finite universal C is proved.
